prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Transform this Gormolzavod smoked kurt packaging concept into a compact HORIZONTAL BAR-SIZED VACUUM PACK. The requested reference to a chocolate bar is STRUCTURE AND PROPORTIONS ONLY: no Snickers brand, no chocolate, no candy lettering, no imitation of its trade dress. Keep the reference's Gormolzavod Kokshetau brand, deep blue/ivory palette, mountain-and-lake scenery, small restrained Kazakh ornament border. Change the previous cone silhouette completely to a long low rectangular flexible wrapper with crimped cross seals at BOTH SHORT ENDS and longitudinal fin seal on the rear. Realistic tight vacuum film follows FIVE golden solid round kurt pieces in one single horizontal row. Total NET WEIGHT 60 g, nominal five pieces 12g each. No solid chocolate bar, no compressed kurt brick, no multiple rows, no plastic tray, no zip, no fabric, no string. Shape wider than tall roughly 4.5 to 1 in front view; clear food-grade film taut and slightly puckered between individual spheres, but printed title panel sufficiently smooth and readable. Avoid a puffy air-filled snack pillow.
Presentation: landscape studio board, warm beige background, three staggered views with generous space: large front three-quarter hero wrapper across upper center, a smaller full rear view below left, and a close-up partially torn-open end below right revealing actual kurt. All represent the SAME 60g package. Seal on right of opened view has been torn, a golden kurt ball visible immediately inside the film, no hand. The closed hero has both end seals intact.
Artwork: deep blue seal ends, ivory center with blue mountain/lake band across top, thin ornamental blue trim along bottom. Authentic complete Gormolzavod logo at left of hero, upright and readable. Kazakh first "ҚҰРТ ЫСТАЛҒАН", Russian underneath "Курт копчёный", bold readable dark blue, adaptable to narrow wrapper. Clear LONG WINDOW along lower front reveals several golden kurt pieces; avoid printed kurt photos that obscure the actual contents. Weight exactly "60 г" plus small "Таза салмағы / Масса нетто". Integrated small white QR placeholder labeled "QR" at right and small "Кодты тірке / Зарегистрируй код". No real arbitrary QR or barcode digits. No extra health benefits or certification badges. Rear organized compact cream information panel, source data only: "Состав: Творог нежирный, соль поваренная пищевая", "На 100 г: белки — 60 г; углеводы — 17 г", "200 ккал / 837 кДж", "Срок годности: 3 месяца", "Не выше +15 °C; влажность не более 75 %", "ТОО «Гормолзавод»", "ok@gormolzavod.kz"; reserve "EAN-13" placeholder and date/lot blanks. Small label headings bilingual Kazakh first where practical, this is a concept not complete print labeling. Do not invent an EAC mark. No new brand name, no "ДОРБА" or "ҚОРЖЫН".
Board heading "ҚҰРТ · 60 г", small subtitle "Вакуумная упаковка в формате батончика". Footer "Концепция формы". Premium commercial product photography, exact plausible film textures, soft shadows, appetizing realistic golden smoked kurt, emphasis on manufacturable-looking rectangular wrap form and one row of pieces.

prompt: Use case illustration-story. Supporting print artwork for the selected Kazakh Gormolzavod smoked kurt bar wrapper. Generate a clean WIDE LANDSCAPE ILLUSTRATION strip, aspect ratio 3:1, at high resolution, without packaging, text, typography, logos, people or food. Use the attached approved packaging ONLY as a mood and scenery reference. Preserve the character: Kazakh mountain lake, mountain peaks based on simple blue silhouettes, sparse pine trees near the shore, ONE small unobtrusive traditional yurt at far right. Refined screen-print / engraved landscape illustration suitable for flexible packaging. Very restrained palette exclusively sky blue #A4CFFF, cobalt #0861C6, navy #1D3484, ivory #FCF8F3 and off-white #FFFDFC. No dark green trees, no brown, no golden sunset, no black. Landscape fills width, low horizon with calm lake at bottom, pale ivory sky above, fine blue lines. No border, no drawn wrapper or seals, no lettering whatsoever. Background opaque ivory. Aim to reproduce the recognizable lake-and-mountain identity of the selected concept while allowing accurate vector text and official logo to be typeset separately.

prompt:
Use case product-mockup. Create a polished photorealistic presentation board of the FINAL selected 60g Gormolzavod smoked kurt vacuum bar pack. Reference1 is the exact flat FRONT artwork; reference2 is exact BACK artwork; reference3 is the original approved bar-format concept and shows shape and one row of five golden kurt balls. The goal is to apply reference1 and reference2 faithfully to the approved low horizontal vacuum bar shape, not redesign it.
Landscape image. Two large views on ivory studio surface: top-left front three-quarter, bottom-left rear three-quarter, and a smaller right-side inset showing several of the identical bars in a plain retail display tray. All packages SEALED; realistic film tight against five separate golden kurt balls in ONE ROW, no solid compressed bar, no chocolate. Standard straight end seals, narrow longitudinal edge seals. Right exterior tail may be slightly wider to accommodate hidden code on back. No zip, no paper wrap, no rigid inner tray. Clear window in reference1 is a transparent aperture in PRINT, not a white label: render real golden kurt visible through the large blank white rectangular region below the title. Keep visible matrix QR design at right as reference, but do not promise scannability in perspective. Reference2's EAN is a RESERVED PLACEHOLDER, keep labeled EAN-13 with no invented digits or real barcode. Keep all source numbers unaltered 60g, 60g protein per100g,17g carbs per100g,200kcal/837kJ,3months,+15C,75%, but tiny back text may be illustrated only; final legal copy lives in vector artwork.
Use the original logo exactly as in reference1, not the stylized reconstructed logo from reference3. Typeface in reference1 is plain bold sans serif Open Sans: NO serif type. Keep the light-blue/navy/cobalt/ivory palette, the blue monochrome mountain-lake-yurt header, and simple thin blue decorative lower strip. Retain logo white exclusion field. Product name Kazakh first "ҚҰРТ ЫСТАЛҒАН", Russian second "Курт копчёный". Do not add "ДОРБА", "ҚОРЖЫН", Snickers logos, extra claims, certifications, or health icons. Reserve white tamper cover at back right tail with "Код осы жерде / Код здесь".
Large beautiful presentation, soft realistic shadows, detailed food and film. Short top heading "ҚҰРТ ЫСТАЛҒАН · 60 г". Small labels for views "Лицевая сторона", "Оборотная сторона", "На полке". Footer "AI-визуализация · точная маркировка в макетах". Grocery shelf is imaginary demonstration, no identifiable store, no prices, no competitors. Strong fidelity to reference1 and2 composition and selected bar format.
